conditions: Still-image routes use Gemini text prompting when needed, then render through the FLUX local service.
image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded harbor-trade illustration with visible cargo logic, weathered tools, route signals, and no visible text or watermark.
image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Emphasize harbor logistics, route pressure, dock wear, and civic trade signals. No visible text, no watermark.

inventory_generation.policy: Generate compact role-appropriate actionable inventory only from the item catalog. Use property_library for non-actionable treasures, titles, clues, personal tools, debts, or keepsakes. Do not create images here; image generation is a later system step when a route requests it.
inventory_generation.reason: Boutique character node already generated at least eight validated inventory items per agent.

functions.purpose: Create or advance event threads for the The Data Tithe loop so the world keeps generating concrete next steps in Outer Hull, Sanctum, Trading Bay.
functions.event_policy: Prefer compact progress events that deepen The Data Tithe: Players collect fragmented data from the outer hull, purify it in the sanctum, and sell it to visiting merchants. Use Data-Monk, Merchant as likely responders, keep the pressure on Oxygen levels and data degradation rates., and ensure at least one event gives players a readable way into the world such as A merchant vessel seeking to buy ancient encryption keys..
